name: Should I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower instead?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tub-to-shower conversions are common, but you should carefully evaluate your household habits and resale goals. Removing the only bathtub in a home can make it less appealing to future buyers with young children. However, converting an unused tub into a walk-in shower offers easier daily accessibility, streamlined cleaning, and a more open feel. If you have at least one other bathtub in the house, converting a secondary tub into a custom-tiled walk-in shower is often a practical, high-value upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Convert to a shower if you want easy accessibility and already have another tub in the home; keep at least one bathtub to maintain broad resale appeal.
